_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, manufacturing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products for many computing devices'; 'Challenges to our business model may reduce our revenues and operating margins': 'the popularization of the open source software model continues to pose a significant challenge to our business model', and 'Another development is the software-as-a-service business model, by which companies provide applications, data, and related services over the Internet'; 'We face intense competition' (its own FY2007 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, manufacturing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products for many computing devices'; 'Challenges to our business model may reduce our revenues and operating margins': 'the popularization of the open source software model continues to pose a significant challenge to our business model', and 'Another development is the software-as-a-service business model, by which companies provide applications, data, and related services over the Internet'; 'We face intense competition' (its own FY2007 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.07x; -59% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +2.40; conservative 2yr +232%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -30.4%/yr (worst year FY98-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.8%/yr (Q1 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.1%/yr (FY98-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +42.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY98-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2008-07-25) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.07x (31.2% downside to Bear $18 / +458.1% upside to Bull $146) | Adj composite 3.40 vs market 1.00: gap +2.40 [UNDERVALUED] | -59% above the EPP floor $64 (30x FY09E $2.15) | Conservative 2-yr case: +231.6% total (+115.8%/yr) | At 12.2x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $35 sits at or below the BASE case; unearned revenue +21.0% in Q4 FY08, forward revenues +6.8-8.3% (Q1 FY09 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
